# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A tightly compressed EMA ribbon signals low volatility and equilibrium; a subsequent breakdown with expanding volume captures the ensuing short-side move. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede explosive moves, and the volume expansion trigger filters for breakouts with genuine momentum, reducing false signals in choppy markets.

## Mechanism

Define ribbon width as (max EMA(8,13,21,34,55) - min EMA) over the 5 EMAs. When ribbon width < 0.5 × ATR(14) for three consecutive bars, enter short on the next bar that closes below the lowest EMA with volume > 1.5 × its 20-bar average. Exit at the most recent swing high (HH) prior to entry; target at 1.5× risk or trail using a chandelier exit (2.5× ATR). Regime filter: only consider entries when VIX is between 12 and 22; avoid entries when VIX <12 (strong trend, ribbon rarely compresses) or VIX >30 (breakouts often fail).
